summary: RPM-based Ansible Automation Platform 2.5 enterprise topology can be upgraded in place to the 2.6 RPM enterprise topology; the topology is unchanged between 2.5 and 2.6.
questions: Can I upgrade an RPM enterprise topology from AAP 2.5 to 2.6?
Does the RPM enterprise topology change in AAP 2.6?
Where are the RPM enterprise topology requirements for 2.6?
